## About me

My interests are digital analytics, customer relationship management, lifecycle marketing, and retention. I enjoy turning a broad business question into measurable events, useful customer segments, and a practical test.

## Career aspirations

I am interested in future roles in:

- Digital analytics
- CRM and lifecycle marketing
- Marketing operations
- Customer intelligence and retention

I want to work on teams that use data and experimentation to improve the customer experience and long-term customer value.

## Skills

- Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager
- Event design, UTM tracking, tag implementation, and QA
- Toast Guestbook, CRM, and loyalty concepts
- RFM and lifecycle segmentation
- Email and SMS campaign measurement
- Customer satisfaction research and survey design
- Retention analysis and treatment/holdout testing
- Dashboard development and stakeholder communication
